verdict.rationale: Fenwick's IP practice page names open source software as an area of counsel, and the firm runs one of the largest dedicated IP counseling and licensing practices. However, the named open-source item covers new business models around OSS, not license compliance or OSS usage policies. missing for 10: explicit open-source license compliance counseling, OSS usage policy drafting, a dedicated named open-source practice, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability

citations.quote: New business models around open source software
our technology transactions team is one of the largest dedicated intellectual property counseling and licensing practices in the country
